text_block_list.text:
When I visited the cafeteria, No Reason
was eating some sort of spicy-looking ramen.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This kick from the super spicy ramen...
How delightfully thrilling!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Spicy food really stirs things up
in these peaceful, ordinary days!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And while we were talking, it's all gone!
Nay, totally downed!
choice_data_list: Amazing! Not a single drop left!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now I really feel like having something sweet.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Alright! I'll go buy some steamed buns!

After a while, No Reason returned,
holding a steamed bun about the size
of a fist in one hand.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Delicious, so delicious!
I could eat as many of these as you give me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go buy up the rest of the manju.
I believe there were around 50 left...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't that sound nice?
They say there's always room for dessert, after all..."
choice_data_list: Let's stick to just one refill.
I guess there really is a separate stomach for dessert...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... Just one...?
I can eat way more than that.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, that might be true...
I do want my manju to taste good, after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Manju are my absolute favorite!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm stuffed,
I can still keep eating as much as I want!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I'm taking all the buns in the cafeteria!
